authority: Final Aria technical ruling; supersedes proposed A1-A6 only; PO-approved behavior preserved

canonical.objectKeys: ASCII keys, ascending code unit order; no extra whitespace
canonical.strings: Exact Unicode scalar sequence; no normalization; standard lower-case JSON control escapes; reject unpaired surrogate
canonical.numbers: safe integers only [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991], no -0 or decimal
canonical.referenceArraySort: unsigned UTF-8 byte comparison; BMP U+E000 sorts before astral U+10000

identity.source: locked current raw AuthoringV2Request + StudioVariable declarations; base revision frozen columns only
identity.contextLookup: exact referenceId==StudioVariable.name; do not parse URI/name suffix

tokenLookup.secret: actual secretId exact, aliases to same ID dedupe

identity.dedup: referenceId/kind exact; conflicting kinds or different secretId at same key are refused, never merged
identity.sortAndBounds: <=500 unique referenced declaration keys; exact names<=64 Unicode scalars; total referenced arrays within inherited request and canonical limits
identity.derivedDraftCache: Recompute current identity regardless of old authoring_revision_inputs cache. At publication verify frozen manifest identity equals recomputed locked current identity, refresh only derived cache in same transaction before V12 capture trigger copies it. No revision counter/authored data/history rewrite.
identity.frozenSessionSource: manifest gains authoringIdentityVersion=1, authoredDeclarations and complete AuthoringRevisionInputs; positive model projection does not copy private values or entire manifest

hashes.stepInputHash: hash(StepInput schema object: exact stepId,text,normalized stored StepAuthoringContext,sorted per-step declarations)
hashes.testConfigHash: hash(TestConfig schema object); globalContextHash=hash(normalized exact globalContext); references used globally only in globalReferences
hashes.inputChain: hash(StepChain); previous=testConfigHash for position1 then previous chain
hashes.actions: select by coordinate.stepId, ascending semantic ordinal, remove ONLY admissionId; operationHash and sourceInputId retained
hashes.producedBindings: select by producer.stepId; remove consumers and provenance.sessionId/provenance.producerAdmissionId, retain all other/new semantic fields; sort producer.ordinal then bindingId UTF-8
hashes.consumedBindings: flatten full binding.consumers where coordinate.stepId==step; remove ONLY producerAdmissionId/consumerAdmissionId; sort coordinate.ordinal,argumentSlot,bindingId UTF-8
notInLearnedContent: receipt/evidence values not present in learned action shape
hashes.wholeGraphCommitment: learnedPlanHash commits all actions/bindings incl consumers, stepSnapshotHashes,reusedFrom,incremental metadata; publicationEvidenceHash commits all attempt/version/switch/request proofs

boundaryAlgorithm: No confirmed revision=>UNLEARNED; empty draft cannot start.

Verify immutable base and complete authoringIdentityVersion1 + snapshots. Insufficient=>NEEDS_RELEARN at first draft step reason BASE_IDENTITY_INCOMPLETE, omitted-start409; explicit first step enables full learn with no reuse.
Different testConfigHash=>k1; otherwise first differing current/base UUID or inputChain by position.
Strict tail deletion=>last current step. Append=>new first appended step. UUID lexical order irrelevant.
Identical complete identities=>READY even if draft source/config counters advanced for unused declarations.
Client boundary after computed k=>FIRST_LEARN_STEP_NARROWED; unknown=>FIRST_LEARN_STEP_UNKNOWN; wrong base=>BASE_REVISION_MISMATCH. READY explicit N allowed.

ordinaryReadinessParity.replace: ExecutionReadinessService.evaluate term5 draft-vs-base source/config counter equality only; use shared complete identity comparator
retain: confirmed immediate revision of same test/CSI
ordered authoring UUID/text hash and actual execution configuration hash
ordinaryReadinessParity.counterScope: Guided start request and active session current-source checks/publication CAS still require current counters. Ordinary acceptance snapshot and grant remain pinned to immutable revision counters/digest (StudioAcceptanceService:533-534).
ordinaryReadinessParity.schedule: Existing updateTest schedule invalidation for any changed variable/config counter stays; semantic READY never reenables a schedule.

materialization.appendOnly: Existing ordered entry prefix byte-identical; source/config/worker/fence/context immutable; new entry identifiers unique; introducedRevision=current+1
materialization.noOp: Exact existing union returns old version/delivery identity; no insert or revision bump
materialization.staleProof: After append, expired/unaccepted old proof cannot be admitted or consumed against latest context; old successful proof remains valid by pinned historical version
materialization.delivery: Freeze full RunnerContext metadata minus authoredInputs once, reconstruct exact pinned inputs, hash full issued context. Original payload/lease frozen across retry. ACK verifies current owner live plus exact issued contextHash/version/inputs/metadata revision/deliveryId; no model/action while pending.

attemptAndDrift.attemptOrdinal: 0..1; required immutable ledger field+column, server assigned; proposal coordinate unchanged
attemptAndDrift.semanticOrdinal: 0..7 and configured maxStatementsPerStep; effective successful coordinates contiguous
attemptAndDrift.quota: All admitted attempts charge existing maxActions<=200; request probes charge observation/time budgets, maxPrefixRequests=min(maxObservations,400)
attemptAndDrift.preAdmission: no spent action; receipt exact prefix request; first learned replacement uses attempt0
attemptAndDrift.admitted: DISPATCHING/count1 attempt0 becomes immutable FAILED/TARGET_CHANGED plus accepted receipt; fresh attempt1 permitted only same semantic coordinate, no live/invoked/successful prior attempt
attemptAndDrift.nativeFence: Persist NOT_BEGUN -> INVOKING before native API OR -> REFUSED_BEFORE_INVOCATION on recognized pre-native drift; no transition out of REFUSED; journal uncertainty=>UNKNOWN_OUTCOME
attemptAndDrift.authority: current owning-worker RS256 identity and connector mTLS, exact assignment/subject/fence/lease/context/version/request/preparation/operation/evidence; hash alone is not authentication
attemptAndDrift.secretAudit: Per-version joins; prior RELEASE and conservative non-OK USAGE=UNKNOWN_OUTCOME preserved; no fabricated NOT_USED/REFUSED; replacement fresh authorization/read/release
attemptAndDrift.firstSuffix: One immutable acceptance authorizes replacing only unexecuted imported/positively noninvoked failed meanings; exact successful earlier meanings retained. Later plans retain normal strict monotonicity.

publicationJoin.effective: Every actual SUCCEEDED action exactly once at semantic coordinate, current final obligation association and exact historical input version
publicationJoin.excluded: At most one FAILED/TARGET_CHANGED consumed attempt with exact authenticated no-invocation receipt; no other failure/unknown/admitted/dispatching row omitted
publicationJoin.reuse: Exact contiguous fully replayed steps before effective boundary, immediate pinned base only, same test/CSI/step/equal recomputed hash. Retained earlier ordinals of drift step are execution evidence but j has no reusedFrom.
publicationJoin.zeroConsumer: Only exact successful retained-prefix producer, verified origin/recipe/availability; never fabricate consumer; model-created standalone unconsumed need refused.
publicationJoin.inputOutput: Immutable full materialization proof retained; candidate replay inputs/reference arrays filtered to those used by effective actions; authoredDeclarations remains complete.
publicationJoin.retention: V19 prune behavior unchanged, immutable bounded summaries remain separate; raw materialization/history/proposals/plan/commands remain disclosed F01 residual; no generic prune or compliance waiver

resultSemantics.relearnedFromAfterSwitch: entered learning boundary, effective stepId and driftSwitchStepId=j when drift, even if subsequent SOURCE_PLAN fails
resultSemantics.noImplicitFallback: No switch => no fallback to initial plan k; first ever unlearned=>null

requiredFields.incrementalEvidence: null for no base; IncrementalEvidence exact schema otherwise

order.prefixRequests: draft step order, semantic ordinal, observation generation at issued request; tie requestDigest lexicographic
order.excludedAttempts: 0..1, only actual consumed failed attempt; original full action/preparation/obligation association
order.existingActions: effective successful semantic coordinates in draft step order, ordinal ascending

validationBasisExtension.privateInputProof: InputEvidenceEntry.inputHash hashes exact full private input; metadata is exact input minus nonsecret value. SQL/backend recompute from immutable stored inputs before freezing basis; runner pure validator checks provenance/version/hash-reference joins without receiving private values. Header inputCount cutoff determines exact membership.
validationBasisExtension.admissionProvenanceHashExact: hash(ordered array of effective ledger tuples {coordinate,admission,operationHash,scopeHash}); excluded spent attempt is committed by extended basis/publicationEvidenceHash instead
validationBasisExtension.fullLearn: materializationEvidence still required; incrementalEvidence=null; all old fixture heads upgraded in same generation
validationBasisExtension.admissionProvenanceSourceParity: Java ObservedReferencePolicyDeriver:16 declares ArrayNode admissions=ObjectNode.putArray(admissions), whose return value is the child ARRAY; line40 hashes array, not temporary wrapper. TS hashes identical ordered tuples. Preserve exact array and test wrapper negative; no pre-existing parity correction is required.
